purpose: Fail-closed pre-create admission for a zero-cost candidate host. Passing this policy does not authorize resource creation and does not prove persistent-host eligibility.

post_create_gate: Observe the real right-sized workload against Oracle's documented idle-reclamation conditions.
Do not generate synthetic CPU/network/memory load merely to avoid reclamation.
Candidate cannot become an eligible persistent host until durability/recovery and reclaim disposition are evidence-GREEN.

rationale: Current Google VPC pricing charges static and ephemeral external IPv4 addresses assigned to standard VM instances beyond the very small address free tier; BE-06 therefore rejects ordinary VM external IPv4 under a strict 0 USD monthly ceiling.
External IPv6 assigned to VM instances is documented as no-charge, but reachability/TLS still requires post-create acceptance.
The Compute Engine Free Tier e2-micro/storage/egress allowance is necessary but not sufficient for persistent-host eligibility.
post_create_gate: Prove Explorer-client reachability to the IPv6 HTTPS origin.
Prove 1 GiB host runtime headroom for Independent Node + gateway + TLS/OS.
Prove egress remains fail-closed before any billable overage.

result_semantics.admitted: Configuration is safe to request separate host-creation authority.
result_semantics.not_authorized: Admission never creates a resource or grants spend, Explorer binding, LIVE, consensus, wallet, mining, or economics authority.
result_semantics.persistent_host_eligibility: Requires later real-host evidence and be06-host-preflight.mjs eligible=true.
